      "evidence": "Removes snapshot hash parameters from chainparams and kernel headers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to kernel files mechanically remove snapshot parameters without altering kernel API design or boundary abstractions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",

    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC modifications only reflect the removal of the underlying validation capability."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes AssumeUTXO functional tests, fuzz harnesses, and unit tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test changes consist solely of removing tests specific to the removed feature rather than changing test frameworks or runners."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes snapshot initialization checks in src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup alterations follow directly from validation chainstate collapsing."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes multi-chainstate infrastructure and background historical validation across src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and block storage.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Resolving the architectural overhead of multi-chainstate validation removes a major recurring maintenance burden and subtle synchronization complexity. As the author notes, concurrent chainstates require pervasive special-casing across 'ordinary validation changes', including 'candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks', imposing significant technical debt across the most critical consensus code."
    },

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in wallet files are mechanical follow-ons from validation dropping multi-chainstate support."
    }
